mechanism.accumulation: FP32 per K-scale block, multiplied by its FP32 block scale, then accumulated in FP32 and stored as FP16
mechanism.row_invariance_argument: M affects the program grid and masks only; each existing row executes the same fixed tile and reduction tree.

required_for_expansion: At least one configuration compiles on XPU for both shapes
M=31 row permutation is bitwise invariant
M=59 repeated calls are bitwise exact
Maximum absolute difference versus static oneDNN at M=16 is at most 0.06
M=2 latency is at most 2x the properly warmed static oneDNN call for both shapes
No Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, or device loss
gates.on_pass: Expand the best fixed configuration to all six production W8A16 shapes and run the full census before any server build.
gates.on_numerical_or_latency_failure: Preserve the result and test the fixed-M batched oneDNN formulation; do not launch a server.
